CVE-2026-81634.why: Heap overflow in RRSet canonicalisation from a 255-byte query name and a large TCP response. unbound on the firewall is a full recursive resolver for every zone (forwards only internal and 10.in-addr.arpa to dnsmasq), so any internal client looking up an attacker's domain makes unbound read the attacker's own DNS server's responses. Fixed in unbound 1.26.1; OPNsense 26.1.11_10 ships 1.25.1 and its channel offers nothing newer yet.

CVE-2026-82717.why: Progressive heap corruption, possible code execution. unbound on the firewall is a full recursive resolver for every zone (forwards only internal and 10.in-addr.arpa to dnsmasq), so any internal client looking up an attacker's domain makes unbound read the attacker's own DNS server's responses. Fixed in unbound 1.26.1; OPNsense 26.1.11_10 ships 1.25.1 and its channel offers nothing newer yet.

CVE-2026-50252.why: Outgoing query source-port entropy weakened where upstream load balancing depends on it: cache poisoning of the site's recursive resolver. unbound on the firewall is a full recursive resolver for every zone (forwards only internal and 10.in-addr.arpa to dnsmasq), so any internal client looking up an attacker's domain makes unbound read the attacker's own DNS server's responses.

CVE-2026-80225.why: Unbounded consecutive reads on a TCP/DoT connection: denial of service of the resolver, by a client inside the site (port 53 on the internal zones).

CVE-2026-32665.why: Downstream DNS-over-QUIC is not configured on the firewall's unbound (no quic-port).

CVE-2026-40691.why: DNSCrypt is not configured on the firewall's unbound.

CVE-2026-55973.why: dns-error-reporting is not configured on the firewall's unbound (default no).
